simple.meaning: תּוּגָה (tûwgâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “depression (of spirits); concretely a grief.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תּוּגָה (H8424) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 119:28, with occurrences in Psalms, Proverbs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תּוּגָה (H8424) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in תּוּגָה (H8424) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: תּוּגָה (tûwgâh) / H8424 is traced through Psalms 119:28, Proverbs 10:1, Proverbs 14:13, Proverbs 17:21 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H8424. tugah תּוּגָה noun feminine grief (poetry) — absolute ׳ת Psa 119:28 ; Prov 14:13 ; 17:21 ; construct תּוּגַת 10:1 ; — grief Psa 119:28 ; Prov 10:1 (opposed to יְשַׂמַּח ), 14:13 (opposed to שִׂמְחָה ), 17:21 (|| יִשְׂמַח לֹא ).

occurrences.englishText: My soul is weary with sorrow:
Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful,
He who becomes the father of a fool grieves.
